title: Lapse Relativity on a Realigned Named Non-Owner Policy Term
content:
**Rule.** The re-rated full-term premium of a Named Non-Owner Policy term realigned for a DUI requirement carries a lapse relativity that follows the most recent lapse recorded on the term:

- Its days are counted from the first lapse day attested on the latest Statement of No Loss signed for the term (the one recorded first when two share the latest document date) through the last lapse day recorded on the term, both included; a lapse with no such statement counts no days.
- It applies only while its lapse window lasts: the window is the 6 whole months that follow that first lapse day, a month being complete on the same day of the following month. The window lasts while fewer than 6 whole months have passed from that first lapse day to the day of the change; on the day 6 whole months are complete it has ended.

| Lapse days counted | Window lasting on the day of the change | Relativity |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | yes | 1.12 |
| 3 to 5 | yes | 1.06 |
| 1 or 2 | yes | none |
| any | no (window ended) | none |
| no lapse | — | none |

The relativity multiplies the re-rated full-term premium before that figure is rounded to the cent.

**Window boundary (hypothetical).** Attested first lapse day 10 March, lapse of 7 days: a change made on 9 September (five whole months complete) carries 1.12; a change made on 10 September (six whole months complete) carries none.
